crossRefs.note: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine…
“You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of…

translations.web: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.bsb: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
translations.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.asv: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
